reusable_lessons.lesson: When computing denial rates, always use adjudicated claims (claim_status in {Paid, Denied, Adjusted}) as the denominator, excluding Pended claims which have not yet been decided. Including pending claims understates the true denial rate.

When analyzing monthly volume and payment trends, key the series on service_date_from (when care began) rather than adjudication_date (when claim was processed), as adjudication dates lag service dates and introduce inconsistencies in trend analysis.
